items.reason: pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:361-362 returns cached permissions without error on a successful lookup. In the newly added Check logic, a cached result that denies access bypasses the true increment at service.go:131-134 and reaches the false increment at service.go:137. Because metrics.go:36 explicitly names this label cache_hit, this misreports successful lookups as misses and distorts cache-hit monitoring.
